title: An omitted argument takes the default expression of its parameter
query: DEFINE FUNCTION AddTax = ( amount : NUMERIC, taxRate : NUMERIC = 0.1 ) => amount * ( 1 + taxRate )

source.quote: The caller can omit the argument, and the default expression is used as the argument value.
source.supports: the page shows this query with the comment "Returns 11"

notes: The type is left out: it depends on the type of the literal 0.1, which the page does not state.
